title: Document Kimi permission questions on the shared user-input route
outcome: Architecture and Kimi integration documentation accurately describe the shared question card, opaque option IDs, submission and dismissal semantics.
acceptance: docs/architecture.md describes Kimi use of the user-input endpoint/message shape, optional question-option id versus label, and Skip mapping to a reject option or cancelled.

docs/features/kimi-cli-integration.md describes named answer buttons and malformed-choice dismissal consistently with the implementation, without claiming new elicitation/free-form capabilities or a fresh installed-version capture.
